name: Checkstand lane bank, both rows. Full override of the derived zones, for two reasons. (1) The derived checkstand rect [528,426,888,537] stopped at y=537, so the south row's lanes stayed open and the bridged area came out as a single 7834-cell badge-protected pocket instead of per-lane pockets - the lanes rendered walkable. This box hugs the 11+11 register units (x=609-830, y=484-578) on their 21 pt pitch and bridges looser than a counter gap, so the ~13 pt lanes seal while the wide front action alley south of y=583 stays open. (2) The derived r=130 pt (~15 m) service disks are dropped: in this guide the DELI/SEAFOOD/KITCHEN labels do not sit on their counters (SEAFOOD is printed inside the back-of-house room, KITCHEN on a prepared-foods case row, DELI in the middle of the prep enclosure), so their disks bridged shut this store's real 10-14 pt shopping aisles - the Beer & Wine slot at x=500-512 and the Kitchen case-row aisles at y=241-253 and y=263-275. Every staff area those disks were covering is now an exclusion polygon traced from the printed walls instead
